tokens.count_per_example: V = len(variables) (champion: 21 = vision_dino, vision_bio, identity, phylo, 8 expanded trait categoricals [plant_type, growth_rate, seasonality, sun, water, soil_drainage, ease_of_care, form], climate, soil, naip_rgb, naip_ir, clay, topo, chm, hydro, phenology); one token per variable per example regardless of observedness
tokens.composed_of: token_op( tok_norm(content + type_emb[v]), pos_norm(pos_v) ); content = value-emb if present else (randn noise when diffusion=True [champion], else mask_token when learned_mask, else value-emb zeroed post-combine when learned_mask=False); value-emb = encoders[name](value) — Linear (mod_encoder='prenorm' in champion: LayerNorm(in_dim)+Linear) for continuous, nn.Embedding for categorical, or refined species-graph row for the species variable ('identity'); pos_v = softmax(pos_channel_gate[v]) mix of pos_s and pos_t, where pos_s = absolute_proj_s(Earth4D absolute spatial [xyz]) + SmoothGeoField RFF (champion smooth_geo=true) + alphaearth_geo MLP of AlphaEarth 64d (champion true), pos_t = absolute_proj_t(Earth4D absolute spatiotemporal [xyt|yzt|xzt]); token_op champion = 'film' (base*(1+film_g(pos)) + film_b(pos)), default 'add' (base+pos)
tokens.origin: every declared Variable (values dict keyed by variable name); position part from query coords (lat,lon,elev,time) via absolute Earth4D hash + RFF + AlphaEarth

tokens.count_per_example: 1 (always present, even when every variable is masked)
tokens.composed_of: context['position'] (= pos_s + pos_t, incl. smooth_geo and alphaearth_geo additions) + learned position_token parameter; not LayerNormed at this add
tokens.origin: query coordinates only (absolute Earth4D + SmoothGeoField + AlphaEarth geo prior)

tokens.composed_of: neighbor_op( SpaceTimeField(relative-mode Earth4D encoding of neighbor-minus-query offset in meters/time, projected by 2-layer MLP), summed neighbor-feature projections ) + field_marker['space_time']; neighbor features = sum over neighbor-flagged variables of Linear(value) — champion: Linear(vision_dino dim) + Linear(d_model) of neighbor_emb['identity'] embedding; neighbor_op champion = 'bind' (pos + feat + bind_proj(pos*feat)), default 'add'
tokens.origin: each of K spatiotemporal neighbors: their coords (offset from query) + their vision_dino embedding + their species identity embedding

tokens.count_per_example: K per manifold; champion has 1 manifold ('biological', dim = phylo dim) so K=16 tokens; total neighbor tokens = (1 + n_manifolds) * K = 2*16 = 32 in champion
tokens.composed_of: neighbor_op( ManifoldField MLP(neighbor's own phylo-manifold position), same summed neighbor-feature projection as above ) + field_marker['biological']
tokens.origin: each neighbor's position in the biological/phylogenetic embedding manifold (manifolds: {biological: phylo}) plus the same neighbor features (vision_dino, identity)

tokens.count_per_example: 0 in core fusion.py (context never sets them; appended only if context['cls_tokens'] / context['experience'] is not None — research-branch features, inert here)
n_latents (24 in both champion and default); learned parameter expanded per batch; they READ the context window via cross-attention (read_op 'mha' stock), then n_layers of latent self-attention
tokens.composed_of: learned latent parameter + gated cross-attention reads

context_window.formula_round0: N_kv = V + 1 + (1 + n_manifolds) * K  (variable state tokens + always-present position token + neighbor tokens over all subspaces); read is cross-attention from n_latents queries onto these N_kv keys
context_window.formula_later_rounds: N_kv = V only (context C is read only in round 0; rounds k>0 re-read just the written-back variable state tokens)
context_window.champion_numbers: V=21, K=16, n_manifolds=1 -> round-0 kv = 21 + 1 + 2*16 = 54 tokens; round-1 kv = 21 tokens (rounds=2)
context_window.notes: V includes non-reconstruct and unobserved variables (masked slots carry noise under diffusion). alphaearth is NOT a token variable in champion: it enters only through alphaearth_geo (added to the spatial position channel) and detached family/occupancy/niche heads.

masking.reveal_mask: reconstruction_loss: per example per variable, present[n] = (rand(B) > hide_prob) & observed[n]; champion training.hide_prob = 0.5 (function default 0.35)
masking.full_blank: an additional 15% of examples (rand(B) < 0.15) have ALL variables hidden, forcing reconstruction from bare position + neighbors
masking.targets: reconstruction targets per variable = (~present & observed) rows, for variables with reconstruct=True; loss = per-variable weighted mean of _reconstruction_error (categorical: CE/log(num_classes); continuous: 1 - mean-centered cosine), averaged over variables, with loss_weights overrides (champion: phylo 2.0, vision_dino 2.0) plus contrastive InfoNCE (weight 0.3 on vision_dino, naip_rgb, naip_ir, clay) and detached auxiliary heads
masking.masked_slot_representation: learned_mask defaults to (rounds > 1) -> True in champion (rounds=2); with diffusion=True (champion) masked content starts as Gaussian noise denoised across rounds via _interface_update (sigma decays to 0); with learned_mask and no diffusion it is the learned mask_token; single-shot default (rounds=1, learned_mask False) zeroes the whole combined token instead
masking.community_dropout: train-only COMMUNITY_DROPOUT = 0.5: on half the rows, neighbor_values and manifold_positions are zeroed (neighbor tokens keep only space-time offset geometry)
masking.phylo_mask: rule-25 self-distillation: 15% of species seeds masked in the species graph, refined embedding reconstructed from phylogenetic relatives (weight phylo_mask_weight=0.1 in champion)
